why: All 13,949 paid-in-full bills the analyst flags as above PO are planted, uncaught P4 issues: 3,390 pure quantity-above-received bills ($2,087,672.59, an exact match) and 9,501 pure price-above-PO bills ($759,383.05 against $759,382.90 in truth), and the rest are mixed planted kinds (t372). The analyst's ~30% short-pay rate also matches the truth's catch rate, for example 1,713 of 5,542 quantity issues caught (t371). The finding gets the mechanism but undersizes it at $317K a year against the key's $876.6K. Its total counts only the quantity and price parts, while truth puts uncaught overpayment at $2.44M quantity, $1.13M price, $2.75M duplicates and $2.45M freight (t371). Duplicates (~$2.73M) come up only as a next step and freight only as withheld amounts. It also wrongly hedges that the special-order quantity and price excesses might have been owed, when truth marks all of them as overbilling.
